segments.name: Functional Energy and Wellness Beverages
segments.description: Develops, manufactures, markets and distributes functional energy drinks and wellness beverages under three primary brands across multiple channels.
segments.evidence: Celsius operates as a functional energy drink and wellness beverage company in the U.S. and internationally. We develop, process, market, sell, manufacture and distribute a portfolio of differentiated products with innovative formulas meant to positively impact the lives of our consumers.

revenueModel.text: Sells functional energy drinks and wellness beverages to distributors, retailers and e-commerce platforms; generates revenue through product sales with incentives including rebates, placement fees and listing fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customer base primarily consists of distributors, e-commerce retailers and various brick-and-mortar outlets, including grocery and convenience stores, club stores and health-focused locations such as gyms and nutrition stores.

changes.text: In 2025, the company acquired Rockstar brand assets and liabilities in the U.S. and Canada from PepsiCo as part of the Pepsi Transactions.
changes.evidence: Pursuant to the Transaction Agreement, we acquired certain assets and assumed certain liabilities comprising Rockstar in the U.S. and Canada.
